short_blurb: Remodels, additions & ADUs — licensed general contractor in Sun Valley.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Sun Valley. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Sun Valley, including Sun Valley, Sunland adjacent, Arleta adjacent, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Sun Valley?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Sun Valley building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Sun Valley?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Sun Valley rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Sun Valley remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
